pluginText.pf.license: {"need":"No state license for planning or coordinating weddings and events in most places. A local business license where the city or county asks for one: from the state form.","travel":"A planner who sells or books guests' travel or lodging may need a seller-of-travel registration where the state's rules require it: a switch from the state form. The example sells no travel.","alcohol":"A planner never serves or sells alcohol. The venue or a licensed bar does, under its own license.","who holds it":"The business holds any business license or registration. Planners need no license of their own.","what to ask":["The business license or registration number, where the place asks for one","A seller-of-travel registration number, only if the business books guests' travel and the state's form asks"],"how it's checked":"none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie","blocks going live":"Nothing, unless the state's form makes a registration a must for a service the business offers. Then only that service waits.","renewals":"A reminder 30 days before a registration or the insurance runs out.","insurance or bond":"Liability insurance on file, with its end date. Many venues ask for a certificate that names them.","background checks":"Only where the state's form or a venue asks, like for an event at a school."}

pluginText.pf.visit: {"check-in at the studio":"The code at the desk, or read out at the start of a video meeting.","check-in at the venue":"The code, given to the lead planner on arrival by the couple or a person named on the booking.","work changes at the event":"An extra hour only with the couple's written yes by text, at the rate shown before booking. No yes in 10 minutes: the planners leave at the time booked.","vendors":"The planner checks each vendor in against the timeline with their own tools. Rosie never texts, books or pays a vendor.","weather":"Outdoor plans name a rain spot and a large enclosed building. The planner and the couple make the rain call by a set time on the day.","proof it's done":"The lead planner texts DONE at the end of the meeting, or after the send-off and the wrap-up on the day.","results later":"None: the planner's notes and timeline stay on the secure page and in the planner's own tools."}
pluginText.pf.money: {"starting answers":["Full and partial planning: a signed contract, a 30% retainer when booking, and the rest billed in stages, each when the planner texts DONE for it (the example: two stages of 35%); Rosie never bills on a date by itself","Month-of coordination: a signed contract, a 25% retainer, and the rest charged to the saved card when the day is done","Consults, at the studio or by video: paid in full when booking. An extra planning meeting: billed by text after. The free first call: nothing taken","An extra hour on the day: priced first, only with a written yes, paid with the rest"],"limits":["Deposit or retainer cap: from the state form","Free to cancel for a set time after signing (the example: until 24 hours before the first planning meeting, or 3 days after signing for month-of)","After that, a cancel keeps only what the contract's dated schedule says, credited toward the work done, and the owner confirms it. No answer, nothing kept","A late payment gets one pay link and a note to the owner. Rosie never cancels a wedding over a late payment; the owner decides","The business cancels, or the couple says no to a stand-in planner: everything paid is refunded"],"vendors":"Rosie never takes, holds or passes on money for other vendors. Only the planner's own fee goes through, into the planner's own Stripe.","extras":"An extra planning meeting or an extra hour is billed only with the couple's yes.","travel":"Free within 40 miles; the example's $1 a mile round trip beyond.","tips":"Off. The couple's tips for vendors are handed out by the planner, in envelopes the couple gives; they never go through Rosie.","tax":"No tax line unless the owner sets a rate where the state taxes the service.","Rosfield's $2":"Applies: the business pays $2 per confirmed booking."}
pluginText.pf.messages: {"never in a text":"The budget, the guest list, family details, access or health needs and gate codes stay on the secure page. Texts to the owner, the planners or the couple carry none of them: only names, dates, times, places and the planner's fee.","languages":"English and Spanish.","minors":"A child in the wedding party (a flower girl or ring bearer) stays with a parent or a named adult. A planner never looks after a child alone."}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"roles":["Lead planner","Associate planner","Corporate events lead","Office manager"],"skills":["Full planning (leads only)","Month-of coordination","Planning consults","Corporate events","Design and rentals"],"supervision":"None by state rule. An associate planner works with a lead on the day.","who OKs what":"The owner OKs every planning quote, every amount kept on a cancel and any stand-in lead. The office manager may OK meeting changes if the owner sets it.","stand-ins":"A lead planner the owner trusts, even from outside the team, only if the couple agrees. On no reply, nobody is swapped in: the owner calls the couple."}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"written contract":"The business's own contract, filled in from the booking, signed by each partner named and the business before money is taken, for every planning or coordination booking. Any parts the state's rules add come from the state form.","date hold":"The date stays saved for 2 days while the contract is signed (the owner's setting), with a next-in-line list.","one a date":"One wedding a date per lead planner, booked up to 24 months ahead (the owner's settings).","cancel schedule":"Free to cancel for a set time after signing. After that, a dated schedule from the contract, never the whole fee. One free date move 6 months or more ahead, if a planner is free (the owner's setting).","meetings":"Each planning meeting is its own booking under the contract. A meeting missed without 24 hours' notice counts as used only with the owner's OK.","vendors":"Each vendor contract is between the couple and the vendor. The planner may suggest vendors, but never takes a payment from a vendor through Rosie.","venue rules":"Load-in times, the end time, noise limits and insurance certificates come from the venue: switches the planner sets for each venue.","records":"Contracts and payments kept 7 years, as for every kind of work.","weather limit":"A small outdoor party is checked against the forecast the day before (the owner's setting: heavy rain). A wedding has a rain plan instead, called on the day."}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"all":"Every edge case is handled the general way. These matter most for planners:","planning and events":["A late payment: one pay link and the owner decides; Rosie never cancels a wedding over it","The couple cancels: only what the dated schedule says is kept, with the owner's OK","The couple moves the date: one free move 6 months or more ahead, if a planner is free","The lead planner can't come on the day: a trusted stand-in if the couple agrees, or a full refund","A planning meeting missed without notice: counts as used only with the owner's OK","Rain or lightning at an outdoor event: the rain spot, and guests indoors until 30 minutes after the last thunder","A vendor runs late or doesn't come: the planner handles it on the day; Rosie never contacts the vendor","Asked to stay longer: an extra hour only with a written yes","A parent pays: the bill goes to them by a link the couple forwards","The couple opts out of texts: the booking stays, and the planner calls or emails"]}

steps.title: Julian runs the rehearsal at the farm
steps.does: The day before, Julian runs the one-hour rehearsal at Cedar Hill Farm. Julian covers the walk-in order, the music cues and the rain spot in the barn.
more: It's part of month-of coordination, booked with the day. A couple with no rehearsal skips it.
That morning at 10am, Rosie texts the reminder with the plug-in's tips.
Julian meets the vendors with the planners' own tools. Rosie never texts or pays a vendor.
The final timeline is on the secure page, never in a text.
